title: Last time Stovall saw Slim
summary: He last saw Slim in Shreveport at Hosea Hill's Sugar Bowl, with Jimmy Reed on the bill; afterward he bought acts.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: But, uh, so you didn't, did you, did you keep up with Slim during those? No.

After you? No, after the country I did not know. I saw him once after that. I played the keyboarder at Hose Hill Sugar Bowl, which Hose was managing there, and he stayed there with Hose at the hotel, Hoseheader Hotel. And that night we played Jimmy Reed there, Jimmy Reed had a hot number out there. So he came out and asked me, come on, have some dinner with him. I had some meatballs. But yeah, that's the last time I had son. Never met him anymore after that. We never did run in together after that. Cos after then I started buying all the big artists, you know, all I could see on the wall, a lot of them I bought them after I left Slim, you see. So I never did run into a minimum after that. Never did. I don't, I can't tell you what year that was. Maybe it was about a little different. But that's the last time my son was in Tickerdale. He doesn't know what Hose? Yeah, Hose, Shipper, Tickerdale.
